name: Bristle Horn
look: a little armoured hedgehog Shaymin: a pale lavender body under a domed back of red-tipped brown bristles flecked with gold, a grey horn on its white face and a fluffy curled tail
entry: A Pokémon resembling Shaymin, described in a herbalist's notes about a little horned creature whose bristles turned flowers to stone. Given a sprig of petals, it rose into the sky.
how: Wild: very rare by day in hills and meadows.
Sky Forme: put Pink Petals in its cosmetic slot (Rock/Flying, faster; take them out to return).
